stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Stocks: an account is a page of its own, with its profit line and the holdings in the broker's columns. SET / Webull / every investing account and a holding open full screen from the right with a back arrow (class fullpage, left out of the half-sheet drag), not as a sheet over Portfolio. The account page: total value, then Unrealised profit with a line of it by day (each holding's own line added up, ending on today's total), then Holdings as Bualuang's Portfolio lays them out: Stock / Shares / Avg (with the fee) / Market / %, and a Total %, for reading line against line; Cash and pending orders under it; Deposited / Profit / balance in a Details card; Dividends and History as before. A holding's line starts at the buy that began the position now held (IVL sold in October no longer drags it), and its page's avg cost includes the fee as the broker's does. Design by Claude on request. e2e test/ledger-holdprofit-e2e.mjs (page, table against the holdings, account line end; half-sheet mutant red); acctpending, acctrow, motion e2e pass (motion flaked once on '+ turns', passed twice after and on HEAD). Checked on the real SET account: the table reads as the broker's (BDMS 18.33, IVL 21.24). Asked: "Make it go into a new page. Make the graph similar to how SET operates for easy comparison, 5 rows etc. Include the graph per set webull etc in this page too & details below it. Feel free to Claude design it".

papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa news reads Bloomberg, the FT and The Edge Singapore in full, not just their headlines. A page a plain request is refused is asked again through curl_cffi (Python), which makes the TLS handshake a browser's: these sites block on the handshake, not the user-agent. Bloomberg's page carries the whole story in __NEXT_DATA__ (read by bloombergStory); the FT needs Safari's handshake and Google as referrer; The Edge's premium pieces are cut to their opening on its server, kept and labelled as an opening. The three never fall back to the free reader (it handed back Bloomberg's teaser as the article), and reads to them go one at a time, 3 s apart, after Bloomberg blocked the home address following ~8 quick reads. Live, laptop: 12/12 Bloomberg (incl. Google-found Thailand links), 6/6 FT, Edge news whole and premium as opening; Pi, in the papa-news sandbox: 8 Bloomberg and 6/6 FT before Bloomberg's block. Unit 539/539; mutants (quotes dropped, Edge access ignored, reader allowed for the walled three) red. Pi venv /opt/papa-fetch-venv; note papa-news-walled-sites. Asked: "im fine with working around paywalls and bot checks as its a private app. 1. is fine. any methods is fine. i do not want to only read title tbh".
